title: Vietnamese Mozzarella Canh Chua
description: A diabetic-friendly and fluffy post-workout Vietnamese dish featuring mozzarella, this Canh Chua is a unique twist on traditional Vietnamese sour soup, using spherified mozzarella for a fun and healthy meal.
instructions: Combine the shredded mozzarella cheese and sodium alginate in a bowl and mix well.
Slowly add water to the bowl while stirring the mixture with a spoon until it forms a smooth and thick paste.
Drop the mozzarella paste into a bath of cold water and let it sit for 30 minutes to spherify.
In a large pot, combine the fish sauce, lime juice, diced tomato, sliced okra, chopped spinach, chili flakes, and minced garlic.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the spherified mozzarella from the water bath and add it to the pot.
Let the Canh Chua simmer for an additional 5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve the Vietnamese Mozzarella Canh Chua hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
